title: Dionne Warwick Reservations For Two CD 1987 Arista Kashif Smokey Robinson
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Dionne Warwick - Reservations For Two (Arista ARCD 8446, 1987).
UPC 078221844628. Executive producer Clive Davis. Produced by
Burt Bacharach and Carole Bayer Sager, Jerry Knight and Aaron Zigman,
Smokey Robinson, Kashif, and Barry Manilow.

1. Love Power - duet with Jeffrey Osborne, sax solo by Kenny G
2. Close Enough
3. You're My Hero - duet with Smokey Robinson
4. In A World Such As This
5. Another Chance To Love - duet with Howard Hewett
6. Reservations For Two - duet with Kashif
7. Cry On Me
8. Heartbreak Of Love - duet with June Pointer
9. For Everything You Are
10. No One In The World

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
